summary: CI&T Inc filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 3Q26 earnings release and unaudited interim IFRS financials for the nine months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose 14.9% year-over-year to US$146.3 million (11.2% constant currency), adjusted gross margin expanded 420 bps sequentially to 36.6%, adjusted EBITDA was US$22.6 million (15.5% margin), and diluted EPS was US$0.06 (adjusted US$0.09). The company repurchased US$2.9 million of shares in the quarter and raised the low end of its full-year revenue outlook to US$568.0 million, expecting 16%-18% organic growth. No transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics disclosed; routine periodic reporting only.
